answers.text: Quote: 'No break yet is the base I wait in.' That agrees with my claim, it does not refute it: my position-system buy signal is the break above resistance (C26, R13). D close_vs_swing_high_pct -7.54 and W dist_to_20bar_high_pct 7.54 show the resistance line still unbroken. A base is a wait, and my method takes no trade before the break (C19). TIF unread stands as declared.

Quote: 'A resistance break is not my test; a pullback is.' Run on my swing system instead: D last_swing_high dated 2026-11-05, so the pullback has run past the 5-day limit (C4, R7), and cci_20 / ma_40 are not served, so the five-condition set-up cannot be shown (C3). Four of five is not a set-up. No signal in either system.

trigger.plain: Buy stop one tick over yesterday's high; if not taken, re-place it over each new prior-day high (C27).
